storytold/lightcraft.description: LightCraft: An open-source non-destructive photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust
score_reasons: topics: art, photography, raw, raw-editor, raw-processing
storytold/lightcraft.readme_summary: Photo library and raw development; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Lightroom, rebuilt in pure Rust. Native on macOS, Windows and Linux. In the browser via WebAssembly. Drivable end to end by AI agents over MCP.
readme_features: By feature count we're at ~81% of Lightroom (core features 98%), tracked row by row in
As a day-to-day Lightroom replacement we're nearer 61% for the whole product, ~49% for a typical working photographer and ~64% for
The biggest gaps:

camera colour calibration: Sony, Nikon, Panasonic, Fujifilm and Canon CR3 raws have guarded estimates from their camera JPEGs, with built-in ILCE-7CR, ILCE-7M4, X-H2S and X-T4 profiles; measured calibration is missing, and other raws or rejected fits retain a neutral matrix;

compressed Olympus raws and unsupported CR3 variants: these use embedded JPEG previews when present. Fujifilm lossless/lossy compressed RAF now decodes sensor data; verification and existing-library reload instructions;
storytold/lightcraft.quick_start:
git clone https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft && cd lightcraft
cargo run --release -p lightcraft                       # opens your library (~/Pictures/LightCraft Library; a new one starts with demo photos)
cargo run --release -p lightcraft -- ~/Pictures/trip    # import your photos (folders are scanned, duplicates skipped)
cargo run --release -p lightcraft -- --memory           # a throwaway in-memory demo session (writes nothing)
cargo run --release -p lightcraft -- --control 7980     # with the automation channel
cargo xtask web --serve                                 # the same app in the browser: http://127.0.0.1:8080/
cargo run --release -p lightcraft-cli -- render photo.jpg -o out.jpg --set light.exposure=0.5
cargo xtask ci                                          # fmt, clippy, tests, layering, wasm checks

analysis.positioning: LightCraft 是一款用纯 Rust 从零编写的开源非破坏性照片编辑器，定位为 Adobe Lightroom 的净室重实现。它解决摄影师本地照片库管理与 RAW 显影问题，相比普通同类工具，其明确特点是跨平台原生运行、支持浏览器 WebAssembly 运行以及可由 AI 代理通过 MCP 端到端驱动。
target_users: 日常摄影师与专业修图人员，用于本地照片库管理与 RAW 格式处理。
自动化与 AI 工作流开发者，利用 MCP 通道进行端到端自动化驱动。
跨平台用户，需要在 macOS、Windows、Linux 原生环境或浏览器中处理照片的场景。

支持命令行渲染与参数调整，如直接通过 CLI 设置曝光值并输出图片。
具备自动化通道与浏览器端运行能力，结合 WebAssembly 提供一致的跨端体验。

提供独立的 CLI 工具包进行无界面渲染，并包含 xtask 子命令执行格式化、测试与 WASM 检查。
why_it_matters: 项目在核心功能上对 Lightroom 的覆盖率较高，为开发者提供了研究照片处理算法与架构的优质开源样本。
从现有信息看，项目活跃度高，近期有版本发布与代码推送，且具备 AI 代理驱动的前沿技术探索信号。

压缩 Olympus RAW 与不支持的 CR3 变体使用内嵌 JPEG 预览，Fujifilm 压缩 RAF 需验证与重载，可能影响专业采用。
作为 Lightroom 替代品整体完成度约 61%，典型工作摄影师完成度约 49%，功能成熟度需进一步核实。
